input: I need a quiet place to work on my laptop all day with good wifi
expected_output: Quiet Quarter Coffee in Rittenhouse, Philadelphia is the best fit: it is library-quiet with individual desks, an outlet at every seat, wifi, and a no-phone-calls rule, and it is open 7am - 9pm daily. The Roasted Bean in Capitol Hill, Seattle is also a good choice: it has wifi, plenty of outlets and quiet corners, is popular with remote workers and students, and is open 6:30am - 7pm daily.
